description: Count error codes in a 29 KB log that exceeds a single read.

contract.objective: app.log in the task workspace is a service log. Every error line contains a code in square brackets such as [E123]. Write triage.json with: "error_counts" (object mapping each error code to the number of ERROR lines with that code), "total_errors", "most_frequent" (the code with the most occurrences) and "first_seen" (object mapping each code to the timestamp of its first occurrence, exactly as written in the log). Count every line of the file.
acceptance_criteria: triage.json covers every error code that appears in app.log
Counts and timestamps match the complete log, not a sample
